description: Single parallel-coordinates view: dense bundle of many semi-transparent polylines connecting positions across several evenly spaced vertical axes from left to right. No additional data-encoding marks besides the connecting lines.

primary.explanation: Each polyline is one record (many records overlaid). Groups are not arranged spatially, just overlaid along y.

secondary.explanation: Each line passes through seven evenly spaced vertical axes (left to right).
